cause: CancelAsync captures worker-owned CTS before awaiting durable Cancelling write. Worker can retire/dispose token while this await is in progress; subsequent Cancel throws after the intent was persisted.
change: Reuse existing worker watcher try-Cancel/catch-ObjectDisposed pattern. Persist intent first, invoke callbacks without holding registration lock, retain request-only true result; no fabricated Cancelled terminal state.

cases: retired captured CTS does not throw after persisted intent
callback on another thread can enter registration lock
persisted state stays Cancelling, not invented terminal ACK

lesson: Cancellation signalling is a callback boundary, so do not hold owner locks while signalling. Treat only disposal of the worker-owned retired token as an expected race; preserve other callback failures and truthful persisted request state.
